description: Comprehensive Bilingual Thai + English Neurology, Neurocritical Care & Internal Medicine Glossary for Gemini Prefix Context Caching
thai_phonetic_mappings: แอดมิท / รับใหม่ = admit / new admission
ดีซี / ดิสชาร์จ / กลับบ้าน = discharge (D/C)
คอนซัลท์ / ตามเมด / ตามศัลย์ = consult (specialty consultation)
เจาะหลัง / แอลพี = lumbar puncture (LP) + CSF profile
เปิดเส้น / แทงเอไลน์ / ซีไลน์ = IV access / arterial line (A-line) / central venous catheter (C-line)
ใส่ท่อ / อินทูเบท = endotracheal intubation (ET tube)
ถอดท่อ / เอ็กซ์ทูเบท = extubation / weaning ventilator
สโตรก / เส้นเลือดสมอง = stroke / cerebrovascular accident (CVA)
ฟาสต์แทร็กสโตรก = Stroke Fast Track activation
ตีบ / เส้นเลือดสมองตีบ = acute ischemic stroke (AIS) / arterial stenosis
แตก / เลือดออกในสมอง = intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) / hemorrhagic stroke
เลือดออกใต้เยื่อหุ้มสมอง = subarachnoid hemorrhage (SAH) / subdural hematoma (SDH)
ลากก้อนเลือด / ธรอมเบกโทมี = mechanical thrombectomy (MT)
ให้ยาละลายลิ่มเลือด = intravenous thrombolysis (IVT with rt-PA or TNK)
ชัก / ชักเกร็งกระตุก = generalized tonic-clonic seizure (GTCS) / status epilepticus
ชักเหม่อ / ชักเฉพาะที่ = focal impaired awareness seizure (FIAS) / focal motor seizure
ชักไม่รู้ตัว / เอ็นซีเอสอี = non-convulsive status epilepticus (NCSE)
อ่อนแรงครึ่งซีก = hemiparesis / hemiplegia
อ่อนแรงสองขา = paraparesis / paraplegia
อ่อนแรงสี่รยางค์ = quadriparesis / tetraparesis
ชา / ชาปลายมือปลายเท้า = paresthesia / glove-and-stocking sensory loss / polyneuropathy
ชาเป็นระดับ = sensory level (spinal cord localization)
ปากเบี้ยว / หน้าเบี้ยว = facial nerve palsy (UMN vs LMN CN VII palsy)
พูดไม่ชัด / ลิ้นแข็ง = dysarthria / slurred speech
คิดคำไม่ออก / พูดไม่ได้ / ไม่เข้าใจภาษา = aphasia (Broca / Wernicke / global / transcortical / conduction)
เห็นภาพซ้อน / ตาเหล่ = binocular diplopia / cranial nerve III, IV, VI palsy / INO
หนังตาตก = ptosis (Horner syndrome vs CN III palsy vs ocular myasthenia gravis)
ลานสายตาแหว่ง = homonymous hemianopia / quadrantanopia / bitemporal hemianopia
กลืนลำบาก / สำลักน้ำ / สำลักอาหาร = oropharyngeal dysphagia / aspiration risk
ใส่สายยางให้อาหาร / เอ็นจีทิวบ์ = nasogastric tube (NG tube) feeding
เวียนหัว / บ้านหมุน = vertigo (central vs peripheral vestibular syndrome)
เดินเซ / ทรงตัวไม่ได้ = cerebellar ataxia / sensory ataxia / gait instability
คอแข็ง / ก้มคอไม่ได้ = nuchal rigidity / meningismus (Kernig & Brudzinski signs)
เพาเวอร์ / เกรด / มอเตอร์ = MRC motor power grade (0/5 to 5/5)
โทน / เกร็ง / แข็ง = muscle tone (spasticity / rigidity / paratonia / hypotonia)
รีเฟล็กซ์ / เคาะเข่า = deep tendon reflex (DTR: 0, 1+, 2+, 3+, 4+ with clonus)
บาบินสกี้ = Babinski sign (extensor plantar response / dorsiflexion vs plantarflexion)
รูม่านตา / พิวพิล = pupil size (mm) and direct/consensual light reactivity
เคปปรา = Keppra (levetiracetam) IV / PO
เดพาคีน = Depakine Chrono / IV (sodium valproate / valproic acid)
ดิลานติน / ฟีนิโทอิน = Dilantin (phenytoin / fosphenytoin loading & maintenance)
ลาโมทริจีน / ลาโมทัล = Lamictal (lamotrigine slow titration for SJS/TEN prevention)
ทอปิราเมต / โทพาแมกซ์ = Topamax (topiramate)
คาร์บามาซีพีน / เทกรีทอล = Tegretol (carbamazepine - check HLA-B*15:02 in Thai patients)
ออกซ์คาร์บาซีพีน / ไตรเลปทอล = Trileptal (oxcarbazepine - monitor hyponatremia)
ลาโคซาไมด์ / วิมแพท = Vimpat (lacosamide IV / PO - check PR interval on ECG)
เปแรมพาเนล / ไฟคอมพา = Fycompa (perampanel)
บริวาราซีแทม = Briviact (brivaracetam)
โซนิซาไมด์ = Zonegran (zonisamide)
โคลนาซีแพม / ริโวทริล = Rivotril (clonazepam)
ลอราซีแพม / อาติแวน = Ativan (lorazepam IV push for acute seizure)
มิดาโซแลม / ดอร์มิคุ่ม = Dormicum (midazolam continuous IV infusion for refractory SE)
โพรโพฟอล = Propofol infusion (monitor PRIS / triglycerides / creatine kinase)
กาบาเพนติน = Gabapentin (neuropathic pain)
พรีกาบาลิน / ลิริก้า = Lyrica (pregabalin)
เมสทินอน = Mestinon (pyridostigmine bromide 60mg tid/qid/q4h for Myasthenia Gravis)
อิมูแรน / อะซาไธโอพรีน = Imuran (azathioprine - check CBC & LFT)
เซลเซ็ปต์ / ไมโคฟีโนเลต = CellCept (mycophenolate mofetil / MMF)
ริทักซิแมบ = Rituximab (anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody for NMOSD / AE / refractory MG)
เพรดนิโซโลน = Prednisolone PO (corticosteroid taper)
โซลูเมดรอล / เมทิลเพรด = Solu-Medrol (IV pulse methylprednisolone 1000mg OD x 3-5 days)
เดกซาเมทาโซน / เดกซ่า = Dexamethasone IV (vasogenic cerebral edema / TBM adjunctive therapy)
ไอวีไอจี = IVIG (intravenous immunoglobulin 0.4 g/kg/day x 5 days = total 2 g/kg)
พลาสมาเฟเรซิส / เปลี่ยนถ่ายพลาสมา = PLEX (therapeutic plasma exchange 5 cycles every other day)
อาร์ทีพีเอ / อัลทีเพลส = rt-PA (alteplase 0.9 mg/kg, max 90mg; 10% bolus, 90% over 60 min)
ทีเอ็นเค / เทเนกทีเพลส = TNK (tenecteplase 0.25 mg/kg single IV bolus, max 25mg)
แอสไพริน = Aspirin (ASA 81mg / 300mg)
โคลพิโดเกรล / พลาวิกซ์ = Clopidogrel (Plavix 75mg / loading 300mg)
ทิกะเกรลอร์ / บริลินต้า = Ticagrelor (Brilinta 90mg bid)
ซิโลสตาซอล / เพลทอล = Cilostazol (Pletaal 100mg bid)
ดูอัลแอนติเพลตเลต / ดีเอพีที = DAPT (dual antiplatelet therapy: ASA + clopidogrel for 21-90 days)
อะทอร์วาสแตติน = Atorvastatin 40mg / 80mg hs (high-intensity statin)
โรซูวาสแตติน = Rosuvastatin 20mg / 40mg hs
อีเซทิไมบ์ = Ezetimibe 10mg OD (add-on lipid lowering for LDL target < 55 or < 70 mg/dL)
อะพิซาแบน / เอลิควิส = Apixaban (Eliquis 5mg bid or 2.5mg bid renal/age/weight dose)
ไรวารอกซาแบน / ซาเรลโต้ = Rivaroxaban (Xarelto 20mg OD or 15mg OD with meal)
ดาบิกาแทรน / พราแดกซ่า = Dabigatran (Pradaxa 150mg bid or 110mg bid)
เอดอกซาแบน / ลิกซิอาน่า = Edoxaban (Lixiana 60mg OD or 30mg OD)
วาร์ฟาริน = Warfarin (target INR 2.0-3.0 for NVAF, 2.5-3.5 for mechanical mitral valve)
อีนอกซาพาริน / เคล็กเซน = Enoxaparin (Clexane SC 1 mg/kg q12h or DVT prophylaxis 40mg OD)
เฮพาริน = Unfractionated heparin (UFH IV infusion with aPTT monitoring)
นิโมดิพีน = Nimodipine 60mg PO/NG q4h x 21 days (vasospasm prophylaxis in aneurysmal SAH)
แมนนิทอล = 20% Mannitol IV bolus (osmotherapy for increased ICP / cerebral herniation)
ทรีเปอร์เซ็นต์นาซีแอล = 3% NaCl hypertonic saline bolus/infusion (target Na 145-155 mEq/L)
นิคาร์ดิพีน = Nicardipine IV infusion (acute BP control: target SBP < 185/110 pre-rtPA, < 140 in ICH)
ลาเบทาลอล = Labetalol IV bolus/infusion
แวนโคไมซิน = Vancomycin IV (empirical bacterial meningitis / trough monitoring)
เซฟไตรอะโซน = Ceftriaxone 2g IV q12h (CNS dose for bacterial meningitis)
เมโรพีเนม = Meropenem 2g IV q8h (CNS dose)
อะไซโคลเวียร์ = Acyclovir 10 mg/kg IV q8h (HSV/VZV encephalitis - monitor renal function/hydration)
แอมโฟเทอริซินบี = Amphotericin B deoxycholate / Liposomal Amphotericin B + Flucytosine (5-FC) + Fluconazole
สูตรยาวัณโรค / ไอาร์แซดอี = IRZE (Isoniazid + Rifampicin + Pyrazinamide + Ethambutol / Streptomycin + Pyridoxine B6)
มาโดพาร์ = Madopar (levodopa / benserazide)
ซิเนเมท = Sinemet (levodopa / carbidopa)
สตาเลโว = Stalevo (levodopa / carbidopa / entacapone)
ซิฟโรล / พรามิเพกโซล = Sifrol (pramipexole)
เนิร์ฟโปร = Neupro (rotigotine transdermal patch)
อาริเซปต์ / โดเนเพซิล = Aricept (donepezil 5mg / 10mg hs for Alzheimer dementia)
เอ็กเซลอน / ไรวาสติกมีน = Exelon patch / capsule (rivastigmine)
เอบิกซ่า / มีแมนทีน = Ebixa (memantine)
โบท็อกซ์ = Botulinum toxin type A injection (hemifacial spasm / cervical dystonia / post-stroke spasticity / chronic migraine)
neurology_terms: NIHSS (National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale 0-42: 1a LOC, 1b LOC questions, 1c LOC commands, 2 Best gaze, 3 Visual fields, 4 Facial palsy, 5a/5b Motor arm L/R, 6a/6b Motor leg L/R, 7 Limb ataxia, 8 Sensory, 9 Best language, 10 Dysarthria, 11 Extinction and inattention)
GCS (Glasgow Coma Scale: Eye 1-4, Verbal 1-5 or VT, Motor 1-6; E4V5M6 = 15/15)
FOUR Score (Full Outline of UnResponsiveness: Eye, Motor, Brainstem, Respiration)
mRS (Modified Rankin Scale 0-6: pre-morbid mRS vs discharge mRS vs 90-day mRS)
Barthel Index (activities of daily living ADL score 0-100)
TOAST classification (1 Large-artery atherosclerosis LAA, 2 Cardioembolism CE, 3 Small-vessel occlusion SVO/lacunar, 4 Stroke of other determined etiology, 5 Stroke of undetermined etiology)
ASPECTS score (Alberta Stroke Program Early CT Score 0-10: M1, M2, M3, M4, M5, M6, Insula, Caudate, Lentiform, Internal Capsule; pc-ASPECTS for posterior circulation)
ABCD2 score (Age, Blood pressure, Clinical features, Duration, Diabetes for TIA risk stratification)
CHA2DS2-VASc & HAS-BLED scores (atrial fibrillation thromboembolism vs bleeding risk)
RoPE score (Risk of Paradoxical Embolism in PFO-associated stroke)
ICH score (GCS, ICH volume >= 30 mL by ABC/2, IVH presence, infratentorial origin, age >= 80)
FUNC score (functional outcome prediction in intracerebral hemorrhage)
Hunt and Hess scale (Grades 1-5) & WFNS scale & modified Fisher scale (Grades 0-4) for aneurysmal SAH
Spetzler-Martin grading scale (arteriovenous malformation AVM size, eloquence, deep venous drainage)
AIS (acute ischemic stroke)
TIA (transient ischemic attack)
LVO (large vessel occlusion)
MeVO (medium vessel occlusion)
Internal carotid artery (ICA: cervical, petrous, lacerum, cavernous, clinoid, ophthalmic, communicating segments; T-occlusion)
Middle cerebral artery (MCA: M1 sphenoidal/horizontal, M2 insular, M3 opercular, M4 cortical segments; lenticulostriate perforators)
Anterior cerebral artery (ACA: A1 pre-communicating, A2 post-communicating, A3 pericallosal, recurrent artery of Heubner)
Posterior cerebral artery (PCA: P1 pre-communicating, P2 ambient, P3 quadrigeminal, P4 calcarine, artery of Percheron)
Vertebrobasilar system (Vertebral artery V1-V4, PICA, AICA, SCA, Basilar artery, top of the basilar syndrome)
Brainstem syndromes (Wallenberg lateral medullary syndrome, Dejerine medial medullary, Weber, Benedikt, Claude, Millard-Gubler, Foville, Locked-in syndrome, One-and-a-half syndrome)
Lacunar syndromes (Pure motor hemiparesis, Pure sensory stroke, Ataxic hemiparesis, Dysarthria-clumsy hand syndrome, Sensorimotor stroke)
Cardioembolic stroke (Non-valvular atrial fibrillation NVAF, left ventricular thrombus, infective endocarditis, mechanical prosthetic valve, PFO with atrial septal aneurysm)
ESUS (embolic stroke of undetermined source)
ICAD (intracranial atherosclerotic disease)
Moyamoya disease / syndrome
CADASIL / CARASIL
Cervical artery dissection (carotid / vertebral dissection)
RCVS (reversible cerebral vasoconstriction syndrome)
PRES (posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome)
Mechanical thrombectomy (MT: stent-retriever, contact aspiration, combined Solumbra technique; mTICI reperfusion grades 0, 1, 2a, 2b, 2c, 3; door-to-groin time, onset-to-recanalization time)
Intravenous thrombolysis (IVT: door-to-needle time < 45 min, extended window wake-up stroke DWI-FLAIR mismatch or CTP penumbra mismatch DEFUSE-3 / DAWN criteria)
Hemorrhagic transformation (ECASS classification: HI1, HI2, PH1, PH2; symptomatic ICH sICH)
Malignant MCA infarction (decompressive hemicraniectomy within 48 hours, midline shift, uncal/transtentorial herniation)
ICH (hypertensive hemorrhage: putamen/basal ganglia, thalamus, pons, cerebellum, lobar cerebral amyloid angiopathy CAA Boston criteria 2.0)
CVST (cerebral venous sinus thrombosis: superior sagittal sinus, transverse/sigmoid sinus, cavernous sinus, deep venous system, empty delta sign, cord sign)
Status epilepticus (SE: convulsive SE, refractory SE RSE, super-refractory SE SRSE, NORSE new-onset refractory status epilepticus, FIRES)
ILAE seizure classification (Focal aware, Focal impaired awareness FIAS, Focal to bilateral tonic-clonic FBTCS, Generalized tonic-clonic GTCS, Absence, Myoclonic, Atonic, Epileptic spasms)
Post-ictal Todd paresis
Mesial temporal sclerosis (MTS / hippocampal sclerosis)
Autoimmune-associated epilepsy

EEG & ACNS Critical Care EEG Terminology (PDs periodic discharges, LPDs lateralized periodic discharges, GPDs generalized periodic discharges, BIPDs, LRDA lateralized rhythmic delta activity, GRDA, BIRDs brief potentially ictal rhythmic discharges, ICTAL-INTERICTAL CONTINUUM IIC, triphasic waves, hypsarrhythmia, 3-Hz spike-and-wave, burst-suppression)

GBS (Guillain-Barre syndrome: AIDP acute inflammatory demyelinating polyradiculoneuropathy, AMAN acute motor axonal neuropathy, AMSAN, Miller Fisher syndrome MFS triad ophthalmoplegia-ataxia-areflexia with anti-GQ1b antibody, Bickerstaff brainstem encephalitis, Brighton criteria Level 1-4, CSF albuminocytologic dissociation)
CIDP (chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyradiculoneuropathy: typical CIDP vs nodopathies anti-NF155 / anti-CNTN1 / anti-CASPR1)

Myasthenia Gravis (MG: MGFA clinical classification I to V, ocular MG vs generalized MG, myasthenic crisis vs cholinergic crisis, AChR binding/blocking/modulating Ab, anti-MuSK Ab, anti-LRP4 Ab, thymoma / thymic hyperplasia, CT chest for thymoma, bedside NIF negative inspiratory force & FVC forced vital capacity monitoring, Ice pack test, Cogan lid twitch, RNS decremental response > 10%, SFEMG increased jitter)
Lambert-Eaton myasthenic syndrome (LEMS: anti-P/Q-type VGCC antibody, small cell lung cancer SCLC screening, post-exercise facilitation, high-frequency RNS increment > 60-100%)

NMOSD (Neuromyelitis Optica Spectrum Disorder: AQP4-IgG cell-based assay CBA, area postrema syndrome intractable hiccups/vomiting, acute optic neuritis, LETM longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis >= 3 vertebral segments, diencephalic syndrome)
MOGAD (MOG antibody-associated disease: anti-MOG IgG, bilateral optic neuritis with perineural enhancement, ADEM, conus medullaris myelitis)

Multiple Sclerosis (MS: 2017 McDonald criteria dissemination in space DIS and dissemination in time DIT, Dawson fingers, juxtacortical/periventricular/infratentorial/spinal cord lesions, CSF-restricted oligoclonal bands OCB, kappa free light chain, EDSS score)

Autoimmune & Paraneoplastic Encephalitis (Graus criteria: anti-NMDAR with ovarian teratoma screening, extreme delta brush on EEG, orofacial dyskinesia; anti-LGI1 with faciobrachial dystonic seizures FBDS and hyponatremia; anti-CASPR2 Morvan syndrome; anti-AMPAR; anti-GABA-B; anti-GABA-A; anti-DPPX; anti-IgLON5; anti-GFAP astrocytopathy; onconeuronal antibodies Hu, Yo, Ri, Ma2, CV2/CRMP5, Amphiphysin, SOX1, GAD65)

CNS Infections (Acute bacterial meningitis: S. pneumoniae, N. meningitidis, S. suis associated with raw pork exposure in Thailand causing sensorineural hearing loss, L. monocytogenes; Tuberculous meningitis TBM: Marais criteria, basal meningeal enhancement, hydrocephalus, tuberculoma, vasculitic infarct, CSF low glucose, high protein, lymphocytic pleocytosis, CSF GeneXpert MTB/RIF Ultra, TB PCR, ADA; Cryptococcal meningitis: CSF opening pressure > 25 cmH2O, India ink, CrAg lateral flow assay, fungal culture, IRIS immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome; Eosinophilic meningitis: Angiostrongylus cantonensis, Gnathostoma spinigerum; Viral encephalitis: HSV-1 temporal lobe hemorrhage/necrosis, VZV vasculopathy, Japanese encephalitis virus JEV thalamic lesions, Dengue encephalopathy)

Movement Disorders (Idiopathic Parkinson disease UK Brain Bank / MDS criteria: bradykinesia, rest tremor, cogwheel rigidity, postural instability, Hoehn and Yahr stage 1-5, MDS-UPDRS, wearing-off, peak-dose dyskinesia, freezing of gait; Atypical parkinsonism: MSA-P / MSA-C hot cross bun sign / putaminal rim sign, PSP hummingbird sign / vertical supranuclear gaze palsy, CBD asymmetric apraxia / alien limb, DLB visual hallucinations / REM sleep behavior disorder RBD; Essential tremor; Huntington disease CAG repeat; Wilson disease ceruloplasmin, 24-hr urine copper, Kayser-Fleischer ring, face of the giant panda sign; Hemifacial spasm; Blepharospasm; Cervical dystonia; Tardive dyskinesia; Drug-induced parkinsonism)

Motor Neuron & Neuromuscular Diseases (ALS amyotrophic lateral sclerosis Awaji / Gold Coast criteria: combined UMN + LMN signs in bulbar/cervical/thoracic/lumbosacral regions, split-hand sign, riluzole, edaravone, NIV BiPAP; Kennedy disease SBMA; Spinal muscular atrophy SMA; Polymyositis / Dermatomyositis / Immune-mediated necrotizing myopathy IMNM anti-HMGCR & anti-SRP; Hypokalemic periodic paralysis / Thyrotoxic periodic paralysis common in Thai males)

Electrodiagnostic Medicine (NCS/EMG: motor nerve conduction study CMAP latency, amplitude, conduction velocity CV; sensory SNAP; F-wave minimum latency; H-reflex; blink reflex; needle EMG insertional activity, fibrillation potentials, positive sharp waves PSW, fasciculation potentials, complex repetitive discharges CRD, myotonic discharges, MUAP duration/amplitude/polyphasia, neurogenic early vs reduced recruitment vs myopathic early recruitment)

Neuroimaging & Vascular Diagnostics (NCCT brain, CTA brain and neck aortic arch to vertex, CT perfusion CTP core CBF < 30% vs Tmax > 6s penumbra mismatch, CTV cerebral venography; MRI brain 1.5T / 3T: DWI b1000 & ADC map acute cytotoxic edema, FLAIR, T2W, SWI / GRE microbleeds & cortical superficial siderosis, T1W pre/post gadolinium, 3D TOF MRA, MRV, high-resolution vessel wall MRI VWI; Digital subtraction angiography DSA 4-vessel cerebral angiogram; Carotid duplex ultrasound PSV/EDV NASCET stenosis grading; Transcranial Doppler TCD Lindegaard ratio for vasospasm & bubble study for right-to-left shunt PFO)

Neuro-Cardiology & Systemic Workup (TTE transthoracic echo, agitated saline bubble study with Valsalva maneuver, TEE transesophageal echo for left atrial appendage thrombus / PFO / aortic arch atheroma, 24-72 hr Holter ECG monitoring, implantable loop recorder ILR, Young Stroke workup: antiphospholipid syndrome lupus anticoagulant, anticardiolipin IgG/IgM, anti-beta2-glycoprotein I; Protein C, Protein S, Antithrombin III, Factor V Leiden, ESR, CRP, ANA, ANCA, HIV, VDRL/RPR, TPHA, HbA1c, lipid profile, homocysteine)

Cognitive & Behavioral Neurology (TMSE Thai Mental State Examination /30, MoCA Montreal Cognitive Assessment /30, CDR Clinical Dementia Rating, Alzheimer disease AD, Vascular cognitive impairment VCI, Frontotemporal dementia bvFTD / PPA, Normal pressure hydrocephalus NPH Hakim triad gait apraxia-urinary incontinence-dementia, Evans index > 0.3, DESH, high-volume lumbar tap test; Delirium CAM-ICU assessment; Wernicke encephalopathy thiamine 500mg IV tid before glucose)

Headache & Cranial Neuralgias (ICHD-3 criteria: Migraine with/without aura, Status migrainosus, Medication overuse headache MOH, Tension-type headache, Cluster headache & TACs high-flow O2 + verapamil, Trigeminal neuralgia carbamazepine / microvascular decompression MVD, Idiopathic intracranial hypertension IIH pseudotumor cerebri papilledema + acetazolamide, Spontaneous intracranial hypotension SIH orthostatic headache + pachymeningeal enhancement + epidural blood patch, Giant cell arteritis GCA temporal artery biopsy + ESR/CRP, Thunderclap headache)

Detailed Neurological Physical Examination Terms (Higher cortical function: orientation time/place/person, attention digit span, language fluency/comprehension/repetition/naming, praxis, neglect/extinction; Cranial nerves I-XII: visual acuity, visual fields by confrontation, funduscopy papilledema/optic atrophy, pupillary light reflex RAPD Marcus Gunn pupil, extraocular movements EOM, saccades, smooth pursuit, trigeminal V1/V2/V3 sensation & masseter strength, facial symmetry forehead sparing vs complete LMN, hearing Weber/Rinne, gag reflex & uvula deviation, sternocleidomastoid & trapezius strength, tongue protrusion fasciculation/deviation; Motor exam: inspection bulk/atrophy/fasciculations, tone spasticity/lead-pipe/cogwheel, MRC power 0/5 to 5/5 across deltoid, biceps, triceps, wrist extension/flexion, finger abduction/flexion, iliopsoas, quadriceps, hamstrings, tibialis anterior dorsiflexion, gastrocnemius plantarflexion, EHL; Reflexes: biceps C5-C6, brachioradialis C6, triceps C7, patellar L4, Achilles S1, plantar response Babinski, Hoffmann, jaw jerk, frontal release signs; Sensory exam: pinprick, light touch, temperature, vibration 128-Hz tuning fork, joint position sense proprioception, Romberg test; Coordination & Gait: finger-to-nose test FTN, heel-to-shin test HTS, rapid alternating movements dysdiadochokinesia, truncal ataxia, tandem gait, Romberg sign; Vestibular bedside exam: HINTS plus head impulse test, direction-changing nystagmus, test of skew deviation, Dix-Hallpike maneuver, supine roll test, Epley canalith repositioning maneuver)
ward_round_workflow_templates: SOAP Note Structure: Subjective (overnight events, nursing report, new symptoms, pain, sleep, bowel/bladder) -> Objective (vital signs T/BP/HR/RR/SpO2, I/O balance, GCS, NIHSS, focused neuro exam, new labs & imaging results) -> Assessment (syndromic diagnosis, anatomical localization, etiological diagnosis, active medical problems) -> Plan (diagnostic investigations, medication adjustments, rehabilitation PT/OT/swallowing therapy, consults, family counseling, disposition/discharge planning).

Stroke Ward Daily Checklist: Neurological stability (NIHSS trend), blood pressure target per reperfusion status, antithrombotic regimen (single vs dual antiplatelet vs oral anticoagulant timing by 1-3-6-12 day rule or ELAN trial early DOAC initiation), high-intensity statin, glycemic control (blood glucose 140-180 mg/dL), swallowing screen before oral intake, DVT prophylaxis (intermittent pneumatic compression IPC / enoxaparin), early mobilization & physiatry consult, stroke etiology workup completion (ECG, Holter, TTE, Carotid/TCD/MRA), secondary prevention counseling.

Epilepsy / Status Epilepticus Ward Checklist: Seizure frequency & semiology chart, ASM serum levels (phenytoin corrected for albumin, valproate, carbamazepine), hepatic & renal function, sodium & ammonia levels, EEG report review, seizure precaution orders, driving & safety counseling prior to discharge.

Neuromuscular Crisis (GBS / Myasthenia Gravis) Checklist: Serial bedside respiratory mechanics every 4-6 hours (FVC < 15-20 mL/kg or NIF worse than -20 to -30 cmH2O -> early elective ICU transfer & intubation), bulbar function & neck flexion strength, autonomic instability monitoring (labile BP, arrhythmia), immunotherapy day count (IVIG day 1-5 or PLEX cycle 1-5), avoidance of MG-worsening medications (aminoglycosides, fluoroquinolones, macrolides, beta-blockers, IV magnesium).
